---
title: "Indicator effects"
subtitle: "Every pre-registered indicator, every study, every period"
description: "Effect sizes and intervals for every indicator tested in the gold, silver, earthquake and numerology studies, with multiplicity-corrected q-values."
---

Each study wrote down its indicators, outcomes, periods and correction before
it ran. This explorer shows every one of those tests, whether or not it
reached significance. The market studies report a difference in means
(indicator active minus inactive, next trading day); the earthquake study
reports a rate ratio (events per day while the indicator is active, divided by
events per day while it is not); the numerology study reports correlations and
an agreement statistic with equivalence margins.

::: {.af-howto}
**How to read this.** In the forest plot each row is one indicator; the dot is
the estimate and the line its interval. The thin vertical rule is "no
difference" (0, or 1 for a rate ratio). Exploration-period results are blue,
confirmation-period results orange, full-sample (descriptive) results green. A
filled dot passed the study's multiplicity correction (q below 0.05, or
equivalence for numerology); a hollow dot did not. An interval that crosses
the rule is compatible with no effect. In the heatmap the colour is the
standardised effect (red above zero, blue below), and a ringed cell passed the
correction. Hover any mark for the pre-registered definition and the numbers.
:::

```{ojs}
res = FileAttachment("../data/results.json").json()
STUDIES = new Map([
  ["Gold market", "gold_market"], ["Silver market", "silver_market"],
  ["Earthquake (Himalayan arc)", "earthquake"], ["Numerology and astrology", "numerology_vs_astrology"]
])
```

::: {.af-filters}

```{ojs}
viewof study = Inputs.select(STUDIES, { label: "Study" })
```

```{ojs}
studyRows = res.effects.filter((d) => d.study === study)
groupsAvail = [...new Set(studyRows.map((d) => d.group))]
viewof groups = Inputs.checkbox(new Map(groupsAvail.map((g) => [res.groups[g] || g, g])), {
  label: study === "earthquake" ? "Catalogue" : study === "numerology_vs_astrology" ? "Hypothesis" : "Outcome",
  value: study === "earthquake" ? groupsAvail.filter((g) => g !== "raw") : groupsAvail.slice(0, 1)
})
```

```{ojs}
periodsAvail = ["explore", "confirm", "full"].filter((p) => studyRows.some((d) => d.period === p))
viewof periods = Inputs.checkbox(periodsAvail, {
  label: "Period", value: periodsAvail.filter((p) => p !== "full").length ? periodsAvail.filter((p) => p !== "full") : periodsAvail
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof chart = Inputs.radio(["Forest plot", "Heatmap"], { label: "Chart", value: "Forest plot" })
```

:::

```{ojs}
rows = studyRows.filter((d) => groups.includes(d.group) && periods.includes(d.period))
nullValue = studyRows.length ? studyRows[0].null : 0
isRatio = study === "earthquake"
passed = (d) => d.significant
fmt = (v) => (v == null || !Number.isFinite(v) ? "n/a" : Math.abs(v) >= 100 ? v.toFixed(0) : v.toPrecision(3))
tipText = (d) => `${d.label} (${res.groups[d.group] || d.group}, ${d.period})\n${d.definition}\n${d.measure}: ${fmt(d.effect)} ${d.unit}, interval ${fmt(d.lo)} to ${fmt(d.hi)}\np = ${fmt(d.p)}${d.q != null ? `, q = ${fmt(d.q)}` : ""}${d.significant ? "  (passes)" : ""}\nn active = ${d.n_active}`
labels = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.label))]
```

```{ojs}
effectsChart = {
  const w = Math.max(340, Math.min(width, 1200));
  if (!rows.length) return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="effects-chart"><p class="af-notice">Nothing selected.</p></div>`;
  const offsets = { explore: -5, confirm: 0, full: 5 };
  let plot;
  if (chart === "Forest plot") {
    const lo = d3.min(rows, (d) => d.lo), hi = d3.max(rows, (d) => d.hi);
    plot = Plot.plot({
      width: w, height: Math.max(220, labels.length * 26 * Math.max(1, groups.length) + 80),
      marginLeft: 230, marginRight: 24, style: plotStyle,
      x: isRatio ? { type: "log", domain: [Math.max(0.05, lo * 0.9), hi * 1.1], label: "Rate ratio (log scale)", grid: true }
                 : { label: `${rows[0].measure} (${rows[0].unit})`, grid: true },
      y: { domain: labels, label: null },
      fy: groups.length > 1 ? { label: null, tickFormat: (g) => res.groups[g] || g } : undefined,
      color: { type: "identity" },
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleX([nullValue], { stroke: palette.ink2 }),
        ...periods.map((p) => Plot.ruleY(rows.filter((d) => d.period === p), {
          y: "label", x1: "lo", x2: "hi", fy: groups.length > 1 ? "group" : undefined,
          stroke: palette.period[p], strokeWidth: 2, dy: offsets[p]
        })),
        ...periods.map((p) => Plot.dot(rows.filter((d) => d.period === p), {
          x: "effect", y: "label", fy: groups.length > 1 ? "group" : undefined, dy: offsets[p], r: 4.5,
          stroke: palette.period[p], strokeWidth: 2,
          fill: (d) => (passed(d) ? palette.period[p] : palette.surface),
          title: tipText, tip: true
        }))
      ]
    });
  } else {
    const cols = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => `${d.group} · ${d.period}`))];
    const ext = d3.max(rows, (d) => Math.abs(d.z ?? 0)) || 1;
    plot = Plot.plot({
      width: w, height: Math.max(220, labels.length * 28 + 90),
      marginLeft: 230, marginBottom: 50, style: plotStyle,
      x: { domain: cols, label: null, tickFormat: (c) => { const [g, p] = c.split(" · "); return `${res.groups[g] || g}, ${p}`; }, tickRotate: -12 },
      y: { domain: labels, label: null },
      color: { type: "diverging", scheme: undefined, range: palette.div, domain: [-ext, ext], pivot: 0,
               legend: true, label: isRatio ? "log2 rate ratio" : study === "numerology_vs_astrology" ? "r or kappa" : "effect / SE (z)" },
      marks: [
        Plot.cell(rows, {
          x: (d) => `${d.group} · ${d.period}`, y: "label", fill: (d) => d.z ?? 0, inset: 1, rx: 3,
          stroke: (d) => (passed(d) ? palette.ink : null), strokeWidth: 2, title: tipText, tip: true
        })
      ]
    });
  }
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="effects-chart">${plot}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
chart === "Forest plot"
  ? swatchLegend([
      ...periods.map((p) => ({ color: palette.period[p], label: { explore: "Exploration period", confirm: "Confirmation period", full: "Full sample (descriptive)" }[p] })),
      { color: palette.ink2, label: "Filled: passes the correction; hollow: does not", hollow: true }
    ])
  : swatchLegend([{ color: palette.ink, label: "Ringed cell: passes the correction", hollow: true }])
```

```{ojs}
htl.html`<p class="af-caption">${rows.length} tests shown; ${rows.filter(passed).length} pass the study's correction.
  Study-wide alpha ${res.alpha}. The correction is the one pre-registered by each study
  (Benjamini-Yekutieli for markets and earthquakes; TOST equivalence for numerology).</p>`
```
